items.response: Eg. "Malpensa Delivery, ASX415, Airbus a320, Stand 123, Information B, Request clearance to Venezia Tessera"
Found: read back clearance. Not found: "Stand-By, ASX415". If still not found: "Unable <SID name>, not in database, request radar vectors / direct <FIX>, ASX415"

Eg. "Malpensa Ground, ASX415, Stand 123, Ready for taxi"

items.text: Obtain Takeoff or Line Up Clearance
items.response: Eg. "Malpensa Ground, ASX415, Holding point B, Runway 35L, Ready for departure"
Eg. RB: "Runway 35L, Cleared for takeoff, ASX415"

items.text: If the crosswind is at or below 20 kt and there is no tailwind: half forward sidestick until 80kt, release gradually to neutral at 100 kt. In case of tailwind, or crosswind greater than 20 kt: full forward sidestick until 80kt, release gradually to neutral at 100 kt.

items.response: MONITOR - MAN FLX / TOGA - SRS - RWY - A/THR (BLUE)

Eg. "Milano Control, ASX415, FL100, Climbing FL180"

items.text: Periodically review system display pages: ENG oil pressure and temperature; BLEED parameters; ELEC parameters, GEN loads; HYD slight decrease in quantity is normal; FUEL distribution; COND duct temperature vs zone temperature; FLT CTL any unusual control surface position; DOOR oxygen pressure.
Check track and distance to the next waypoint
